digital_closeout.decision: Hold this latch design for production; current evidence does not justify a finished-product or reliable-return claim

digital_closeout.do_not_propagate: Do not promote two-sizeV17 pilots into a final six-size product merely because unloaded motion and component mesh checks pass.
